gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (trimmed p5, printed p9) prints Total expenditures 682,831 = General 380,156 + Street 120,194 + Swimming Pool 38,413 + Other Governmental Funds 144,068; the Debt Service Fund expenditure column is blank because the statement prints that fund's Debt principal payments (105,000) and Debt interest payments (55,638) under Other Financing Sources (Uses) (p6, printed p10). The Debt Service Fund budget schedule (p16) prints the same money as disbursements, Total disbursements 160,638 (= 105,000 + 55,638), and detail follows the schedule. Detail 843,469 = 380,156 + 120,194 + 160,638 + 38,413 + 144,068 (nonmajor combining p21: Park 31,690 + Library 129 + Cemetery 23,639 + Fitness Center 4,986 + Library Board 65,109 + Parks and Recreation Board 1,524 + Community Ambulance 16,991). 843,469 - 682,831 = 160,638 = the Debt Service schedule disbursements shown as other financing on the statement. Nothing missing or duplicated; no fix.

Statement business-type disbursements 195,097 (Statement of Activities, p2) = proprietary modified cash statement total operating expenditures 156,552 + Debt payments 21,569 + Interest expense 16,976 (p8, printed p12). The Water Enterprise Fund budget schedule (p19) prints Total disbursements 137,776 (incl. Interest expense 16,976) and prints Debt payments (21,569) separately under Other Financing Uses (in detail as other financing -21,569); Sewer schedule (p20) Total disbursements 35,752. 137,776 + 35,752 = 173,528; 195,097 - 173,528 = 21,569 = the Water Fund debt payments the schedule prints as other financing and the statement total counts as a disbursement. Nothing missing; no fix.
